title: PR body mis-describes the node_health 20000ms re-bless as carrying "the ring burst" — no telegraph can exist in that golden
evidence:
_pr_body_spawn_feel.md: "- **`node_health` 20000ms** — the capture tick lands exactly on a growth
  window (t400); the frame now carries the reveal at age 0 (the new node at
  scale 0.4/fade 0.3 + the ring burst + the highlight)."

demos/node_health.dem:36-38: "capture at 50ms / capture at 10000ms / capture at 20000ms" (ticks 1, 200, 400)

app/render/spawn_fx.odin:269-272: "	window := tick + u64(interval) - (tick % u64(interval))
	lead := window - tick
	if lead > SPAWN_LEAD_TICKS {"

harness/run.odin:508 (the ONLY harness predict call site, inside the capture block): "				rnd.spawn_fx_predict(&rc.view, &state, cat, sim_tick, state.action_log[:], true)"
detail: The re-bless cause is real (NODE_SPAWNED at t400 verified by re-sim), but the harness only predicts at capture ticks 1/200/400 — all with lead > SPAWN_LEAD_TICKS, so telegraph_valid stays false all demo; no ring burst renders in that golden.
recommended_fix: Correct the PR body: the 20000ms frame carries the reveal + placement highlight only. Optionally add a capture inside a lead window (e.g. 19900ms) if ring coverage in node_health is wanted.

title: Placement feedback highlights ALL pipes within 8 tiles, not the spec's "connecting pipe"
detail: Spec says highlight "the connecting pipe"; the code pulses every pipe whose midpoint lies within 8 tiles — a wider glow than specified. Documented in the PR body as the honest reading since a fresh spawn has no pipes.
recommended_fix: Accepted interpretation, but consider narrowing the radius toward growth_groups.radius_tiles (5) or the nearest pipe only, so the pulse reads as joining, not area-wide glow.

title: spawn_fx_test's sfx_fixture claims to be "the growth.dem recipe's seed topology" but its base node positions differ from the harness fixture
detail: The comment claims demo-recipe fidelity; only the placed router matches. The predict==actual pins still hold (self-consistent fixture), but the tests do not exercise the mesh the shipped spawn_feel goldens use.
recommended_fix: Either align sfx_fixture to FIXTURE_*_POS {(8,15),(20,15),(32,15)} so the pins cover the golden's actual topology, or reword the comment to say 'a growth-like fixture'.
